claim_boundary: Published even-characteristic cubic cover classifications, including a reported roughly three-quarter weak density for even base-field degree, prevent a global new-family claim. The two-common-pole product gate is Hess's known double-trace-zero branch and its exact count was already proved in this repository. The exact all-q overlap formula with the triangle gate and the q16 evaluated witness are new evidence in this audit, with publication novelty unresolved. Two catalog-unknown isogeny classes have explicit positive Jacobian witnesses, with equation-level publication novelty unresolved. The two-pole 4132 class is already catalog-positive.

family_sources.title: Generalising the GHS Attack on the Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem
family_sources.finding: Section 6 explicitly discusses the branch with both Artin-Schreier factors of relative trace zero. The local research/ghs_hess_c_parameter_audit_20261026/EXACT_CUBIC_FAMILY.md already proves the same product criterion and exact all-q count used for the two-common-pole gate here.

family_sources.title: Classification of Weil Restrictions Obtained by (2,...,2) Coverings of P^1
family_sources.finding: Abstract states general (2,...,2) Weil-restriction classification and explicit equations; full PDF fetch failed with HTTP 403.

family_sources.title: Genus 3 curves with many involutions and application to maximal curves in characteristic 2
family_sources.finding: Characteristic-two genus-three V4 curves with three elliptic quotients and product Jacobian isogeny are prior art.

family_sources.title: A classification of elliptic and hyperelliptic curves over finite fields of even characteristic subjected to the cover attack under the isogeny condition
family_sources.authors: Kousuke Murai, Mahoro Shimura, Tsutomu Iijima, and Jinhui Chao
family_sources.finding: Primary abstract explicitly reports complete even-characteristic classification for genus-one through genus-three sources under g(C)=d*g(E); full case table not in abstract.

family_sources.title: Elliptic curves with weak coverings over cubic extensions of finite fields with even characteristic I and II
family_sources.authors: Mahoro Shimura, Fumiyuki Momose, and Jinhui Chao
family_sources.finding: The primary 2013 paper's reference list identifies two earlier SCIS papers directly on even-characteristic cubic weak elliptic covers; their full texts were not obtained, so exact overlap with this trace gate is unresolved.

family_sources.title: Classification of covering curves for hyperelliptic curves over finite-field extensions and cryptographic applications
family_sources.authors: Mahoro Shimura with Fumiyuki Momose and Jinhui Chao
family_sources.finding: The Waseda seminar abstract reports that for characteristic two and cubic elliptic sources, weak-curve density is about three-quarters when the base field has even degree over F2 and about one-half when it has odd degree. This exceeds the present exact one-half construction at q=16.

family_sources.title: Classification of ordinary elliptic curves over even-characteristic finite fields subject to cover attacks without the isogeny condition
family_sources.authors: Yusuke Uesato, Mahoro Shimura, and Jinhui Chao
family_sources.finding: SCIS program abstract 3A1-4 reports a classification of all ordinary even-characteristic elliptic curves with non-isogeny-condition covers for extension degrees at most nine; exact case tables were not obtained.

family_sources.title: Classification of Elliptic and Hyperelliptic Curves over Finite Fields of Even Characteristics Subject to Cover Attack
family_sources.finding: Poster states a broader genus-evaluation classification; its listed domain includes genus-one sources with g(x) in the base-field polynomial ring and coprime base-field and extension degrees. The q=16 cubic normalized source meets those conditions, but exact overlap with its case list is unverified.

family_sources.title: A Classification of Elliptic and Hyperelliptic Curves over Finite Fields of Even Characteristic Subjected to the Cover Attack
family_sources.finding: Thesis repository metadata confirms complete-classification claim; full text marked access restricted.

family_sources.title: On the discrete logarithm problem for plane curves
family_sources.finding: Theorem 1 gives expected soft-O(q) for non-hyperelliptic genus-three Jacobian DLP, an asymptotic bound for this quartic cover family after transfer.

family_sources.title: Cover and Decomposition Index Calculus on Elliptic Curves made practical
family_sources.finding: Appendix A.2 describes the characteristic-two genus-three hyperelliptic direct-cover condition Tr_K/k(b)=0; this is a narrower geometric route than the present non-hyperelliptic triangle cover.

family_sources.title: Cover attacks for elliptic curves with prime order
family_sources.finding: Cubic-extension transfer through a non-hyperelliptic genus-three Jacobian with soft-O(q) DLP cost is prior art. Its homomorphism uses an (ell,ell,ell)-isogeny rather than a cover pullback and trace; the paper targets prime-order source curves, unlike the even-order ordinary binary examples here.
